title: ci: retire Spec Coverage and Engine Split Metric; run the showcase smoke in the Nightly Tiers live tier
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi988VUoRMhEaekZbB638HuLE)_
Fixes #26445

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6433804956

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删掉两条没人读的定时工作流（Spec Coverage 每天、Engine Split Metric 每周）；Showcase Smoke 不再是独立工作流，它的整套 Playwright 冒烟改由夜跑 `Nightly Tiers` 里的一个 `*.live.test.ts` 运行。
- 为什么改：裁决 B（6433804956）。三条工作流红了都不开卡、没人看；并进夜跑后，showcase 冒烟红了会由夜跑的 report 步骤开卡。
- 风险与回滚：夜跑分片 1 多约 8 分钟（构建 Console + 装 Chromium + 冒烟本身），仍在 45 分钟上限内；回滚即 revert 本 PR，三条工作流原样回来。
- 先看：`.github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml`（新增准备步骤、诊断上传、分片腿顺序）、`examples/app-showcase/test/showcase-smoke.live.test.ts`、`examples/app-showcase/vitest.config.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：本 PR 改了 `test-nightly-tiers.yml`，所以它自己会在 PR 上跑一次 Nightly Tiers（分支上不写看板）；看 `Nightly tiers (1/2)` 里 showcase 那一腿的 `53 passed`。
- 需要你做的：这是 Tier H（`.github/workflows/**`、`scripts/pm/**`），请批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

**Retired (deleted):**
- `.github/workflows/coverage-nightly.yml` (Spec Coverage, nightly). Its only product was a `coverage-report` artifact; nothing reads it. `packages/spec`'s `test:coverage` script stays as an on-demand developer command (it is not a `check:*` gate and no workflow calls it after this PR).
- `.github/workflows/engine-split-metric.yml` (Engine Split Metric, weekly, report-only). **The ADR-0076 D7 metric script stays in `scripts/`, unwired from any schedule**: `scripts/check-engine-split-ratio.mjs` runs on demand (its header now says so), and its `--self-test` stays wired in `lint.yml`, so the instrument stays correct while unrun. Keeping it means ADR-0076 still names a script that exists; its sentence naming the deleted workflow needs a one-line note, which is a separate governed PR (this one does not touch `docs/adr/**`).
- `.github/workflows/showcase-smoke.yml` (Showcase Smoke, nightly).

**Showcase smoke moved under Nightly Tiers:**
- New `examples/app-showcase/test/showcase-smoke.live.test.ts`. The `*.live.test.*` name puts it in the nightly `live` tier (`scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs`), so no pull request or merge-queue run collects it. It does not restate any assertion: it runs `playwright test` with the package's own `playwright.config.ts` (all three specs under `e2e/`: the 49 nav surfaces, the ADR-0085 detail shapes, the bulk capability gate), streams the `list` reporter to stdout for the stall guard, and passes only when Playwright's JSON report has no failing test, no run-level error, and at least one test ran. A red names each failing spec (`file › title`) and, for a whole-run red, says to read it as environment first.
- `examples/app-showcase/vitest.config.ts` reads `OS_TEST_TIERS` through `scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs` (`readTierMode`, `isNightlyTierFile`, imported, not re-spelled): under `queue` the tier files are excluded by exact path and the default include is unchanged; under `nightly` they are the include. `turbo.json`'s `@objectstack/example-showcase#test` already hashed `OS_TEST_TIERS`; it now also lists `scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs` (+ `.d.mts`) as inputs, as `@objectstack/cli#test` does.
- `.github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml`:
  - new step "Prepare the showcase browser smoke": on the shard carrying `@objectstack/example-showcase` only, `pnpm console:build` and `playwright install --with-deps chromium` (the two prerequisites the retired workflow had). `continue-on-error`, so a failed Console build cannot take the shard's CLI slice down with it; the smoke then fails as a whole-run red and the night still files a card.
  - new step "Publish the showcase smoke's Playwright diagnostics" (`examples/app-showcase/test-results/`, `always()`, `if-no-files-found: ignore`), replacing the retired workflow's two diagnostics uploads.
  - the leg loop runs the file-level slices first and the whole-package leg last (`for LEG in $SLICES __whole__`), with a comment on why it differs from ci.yml here: the loop stops at the first red leg, and the cheap whole package (the smoke) must not stop the shard's slice of the CLI e2e tier.
  - header comments that named the two retired workflows are reworded.

**Pins and readers updated:**
- `scripts/check-stall-guard-budget.mjs`: self-test battery 10 registers one case per real (workflow, job) with a guarded step; `coverage-nightly`'s job was one, so its floor goes 13 → 12 with a comment saying why.
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: the live-tree case that required `scripts/check-engine-split-ratio.mjs --days 90` in workflow text drops that key (same treatment as `check-prerelease-pin-watch.mjs --verbose` when its workflow left); the fixture row quoting it stays.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`: the showcase item's `source` names the live test and `test-nightly-tiers.yml` instead of the deleted workflow.
- Comment pointers in `half-state-patrol.yml`, `shard-timings-refresh.yml` and `examples/app-showcase/playwright.config.ts`.

Readers grepped (file names, workflow names, job names, artifact names, `test:smoke`, `test:coverage`): `dependabot.yml`, the required-context set, the aggregator roster, `check:self-test-wired` and `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` hold none of the three. `scheduled-full-run.mjs` uses `'Spec Coverage'` only as an example of a name outside its map, which stays true.

## Tests

Local, on this branch (worktree `objectstack-issue-26445`), closure built with `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/example-showcase^...` and `pnpm console:build`:

- Live tier, real stack (`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly vitest run` in `examples/app-showcase`, Chromium from `/opt/pw-browsers`): `53 passed (2.3m)` from Playwright, `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 1 passed (1)`, at `0d08883a`.
- Negative control: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` injected a failure into the Task Board surface only (anchor 1 → 0, blob `cf29f07379cd` → `26b53aa6a54e`). Result: Playwright `52 passed`, Task Board failed twice (with its retry), and the vitest test failed with `1 of 53 showcase smoke test(s) failed, 0 run-level error(s)` naming `showcase-smoke.spec.ts › surface renders cleanly: Task Board`. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Two reds on the way, both fixed in this PR and kept in the test's comments: vitest's worker sets `NODE_ENV=test`, which disarms the dev-admin seed, so global setup's sign-in got 401 (the wrapper now drops vitest's worker env); a randomly picked port that was busy made `serve --dev` shift one port up while Playwright waited on the original until its 180 s timeout (the wrapper now takes a port from the OS).
- Queue tier: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test` → `Test Files 39 passed (39)`, `Tests 484 passed (484)` (the live file is not collected). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck` exit 0.
- `node scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs --check`: `@objectstack/example-showcase owns 1 nightly-tier file(s); vitest collects 39 under queue, 1 under nightly`; CLI unchanged (512 / 85). `OS_TEST_TIERS=bogus` is refused by the config.
- Partition of the nightly document (`--packages` → `partition-test-shards.mjs --shard k/2`): shard 1 = `@objectstack/cli 1/2` + `@objectstack/example-showcase` (kept whole, "not the run's floor"), shard 2 = `@objectstack/cli 2/2`. `nightly-tiers.mjs --self-test` and `partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured on a runner by this PR itself:** `test-nightly-tiers.yml` is in its own `pull_request` paths filter, so this PR runs Nightly Tiers on a hosted runner (branch runs never write to the board). That run is the first reading of the prepare step and the smoke under turbo's strict env.
- Cost: shard 1 took ~24.6 min on the last scheduled night (run 40275583120). The retired workflow spent ~4.6 min on the Console build and ~1.4 min on the smoke (run 40286891669), so shard 1 should land near 33 min against its 45-minute limit. The partitioner weighs the showcase by its queue-tier timing (48 s) and does not know the live run's cost; if shard 1 gets tight, the lever is the matrix, not this file.
- Not changed, read-only for this card: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` L810 still says "coverage-nightly workflow" in a comment. Left as dated readings: `docs-deploy.yml` (cron-hour survey "on the day this landed"), `lint.yml` L1495 (a 2026-08-21 measurement), `scripts/docs-audit/README.md`, `check-pnpm-acquisition.mjs`, `check-node-version.mjs`, `check-stall-guard-budget.mjs`'s "measured when this landed" line, and `dispatch-gates.mjs` comments that cite the old workflows as history.
- Follow-up owed (separate governed PR): ADR-0076's D7 line names `.github/workflows/engine-split-metric.yml`; a one-line note that the script now runs on demand.
- Root `test:smoke` (turbo) and the package's `test:smoke` stay: `pnpm test:smoke` is still how a person runs the suite by hand, and the QA checklist items cite it.

## Verification

Gate list derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at the final head: 86 commands at `57f8caa3`, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe: **86 exit 0**. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "86 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". Two were red on the way and are fixed in this PR: `check:stall-guard-budget` (battery 10 floor, see above) and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (1 of 1935 fast-tier cases, the engine split live key). The dispatch-gates slow tier (`node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs --slow`, push/schedule only in CI) also ran: `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2200 cases pass`, exit 0. After merging `origin/main` (`2094edeb`, which brought the shard-matrix reader into `partition-test-shards.mjs`) the derivation is unchanged (86) and the overlapping gates were re-run: `partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`, `nightly-tiers.mjs --self-test`, `nightly-tiers.mjs --check` all exit 0, and the nightly partition is unchanged. Families CI runs (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Build Core, the UI lanes, Nightly Tiers on this PR) are read from this PR's check-runs.

Changeset: none. `skip-changeset` — workflows, root scripts, `turbo.json` and the private `@objectstack/example-showcase` publish nothing.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (CI).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. Nothing publishes; `skip-changeset`.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer brief is Chinese by convention).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
